evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Creating a game does not impose rules or permissions that contradict any other story.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators via URL does not conflict with other stories' permissions or behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round in this manner does not contradict other backlog rules.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing all items is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items for estimation does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding items is compatible with other backlog functionality.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items does not introduce incompatible constraints with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting items is compatible with adding/editing and does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Allowing the moderator to reveal estimates before all estimators have given them contradicts participant stories that require estimates to be shown simultaneously only after all have given (PP-033) and expectations about changing until the last person selects (PP-034, PP-041).

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average does not conflict with other stories' behaviors or permissions.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling when all show the same card is not incompatible with other rules (it triggers when all have shown).

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manually entering agreed estimate does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating earlier stories is compatible with backlog features.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories does not impose rules conflicting with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste importing is compatible with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games does not contradict other stories (deletion is conditional and not absolute).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is compatible with export/delete behaviors; not inherently inconsistent.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts does not conflict with other stories' rules.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting as CSV is compatible with other functionality.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Allowing deletion of a game does not inherently contradict other stories (they apply to non-deleted games).

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation requirements do not conflict with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login behavior is compatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Changing account details does not impose rules conflicting with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is conditional and not inconsistent with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display preference does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder by email is compatible with account stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, ...} or {0, 1, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Allowing selection of card sequences does not contradict other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: A maximum of 15 estimators is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining via name entry is compatible with invitation and participation stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Seeing the current item does not contradict other backlog rules.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Seeing the session item list is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Notifying who has submitted (without revealing values) does not conflict with the requirement to reveal estimates simultaneously after all have given (PP-033).

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Requiring simultaneous reveal only after all have given conflicts with PP-009 which allows the moderator to show estimates immediately before all have given.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Allowing changes until the last person selects and simultaneous showing after that is incompatible with PP-009's permission for the moderator to show estimates before all have given.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is not in conflict with other stories about current-round reveal timing.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing mapping of estimates to people (typically after reveal) does not inherently contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer functionality is compatible with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic timer reset when all have played does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Browsing prior rounds is not incompatible with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Consistent card ordering does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: The ability to change until the draw is complete conflicts with PP-009 which permits the moderator to show estimates before all have given (potentially completing the draw early).

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail for personalization does not directly conflict with storage/anonymity or other behaviors in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions supports shared understanding and does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Performance optimization does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser support constraints do not conflict with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility goals are not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance expectation is compatible with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL usability does not conflict with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: User-friendly error pages are compatible with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storing results non-identifiably does not inherently conflict with other stories; UI personalization or metrics could be implemented without violating this requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Collecting metrics is not explicitly incompatible with non-identifiable storage (metrics can be aggregated/anonymized).
